title: Assortment Control Unlocks the Value of Dynamic Pricing in Mixed Last-Mile Delivery
summary: The growth of e-commerce has intensified the need for last-mile delivery systems that can jointly manage customer choice and operational efficiency. We study the Dynamic Offering and Pricing of Mixed Delivery Options problem, in which a logistics service provider dynamically selects and prices attended home-delivery time slots and out-of-home pickup options for sequentially arriving customers. Each decision affects immediate revenue, customer acceptance, and the route-dependent fulfillment cost realized at the end of the booking horizon. We formulate DOPMDO as a finite-horizon Markov…
